plugins.name: ui-ux-audit
plugins.description: Three-phase UI/UX and accessibility auditing: Figma designs before code, UI source, and the running app via Argent. Guided intake, a choosable audit scope, WCAG 2.0/2.1/2.2 A to AAA conformance reporting, reproducible scoring, an adversarial verification gate, and a themed HTML and PDF report with screenshots marked at the finding.
